questions.q: Does Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration close out the SQL Server Database Administrator path?
options: No — it closes out the relational half of the Multi-Platform Databases stage; NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases closes out the whole path
Yes — it is the final course in the entire path
No — it's actually the first course in the path
Yes — because DP-300 is earned at the end of this course
questions.explain: The Multi-Platform Databases stage pairs this course with NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases, and that second course is the one that finishes the path.

questions.q: What does the course that follows this one cover?
options: MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, and Neo4j — document, distributed multi-model, and graph databases
A second, deeper pass through Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL
SQL Server performance tuning fundamentals
Advanced T-SQL development
questions.explain: NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases covers MongoDB, Cosmos DB, and Neo4j — the non-relational half of the real-world platforms a senior DBA eventually meets.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what was DP-300's role in this overall career path?
options: A checkpoint partway through the path, not the end of it
The final certification required to complete the path
A prerequisite required before starting this course
An irrelevant certification not connected to this path
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly reiterates that DP-300 sits partway through this path, consistent with the path's own stated framing.

questions.q: What does this lesson recommend doing once the entire SQL Server Database Administrator path, including the NoSQL course, is complete?
options: Pick one platform close to your actual job and specialize more deeply than a generalist path can
Immediately retake every course in the path a second time
Stop learning new database platforms entirely
Specialize equally deeply in all six platforms covered across both multi-platform courses at once
questions.explain: The lesson frames specialization as a deliberate future choice, made once real job requirements are in front of you, rather than something the path itself decides.

questions.q: What did Chapter 18's Harborline Retail Group project actually consist of?
options: A continuous scenario applying this course's Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL content to standing up, securing, backing up, tuning, and discussing a fictional company's three databases
A single standalone quiz with no connection to earlier chapters
A real production consulting engagement documented for the course
An introduction to a fourth, unrelated database platform
questions.explain: Lessons 91 through 95 built one continuous project narrative that applied the course's Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL content end to end.
